info.name: Customers and Tracking use cases
info.description: Each use case folder can run independently with the shared development environment.

exec: const result=pm.response.json();pm.test('new location event', () => { pm.expect(result.accepted).to.be.true; pm.expect(result.duplicate).to.be.false; pm.expect(result.eventId).to.be.a('string'); });

pm.test('original event returned', () => { const result=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(result.duplicate).to.be.true; pm.expect(result.eventId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('locationEventId')); });

if (events.length !== 1 && Date.now() < Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('waitDeadline'))) { setTimeout(() => pm.execution.setNextRequest('Wait for location history'), 250); } else { pm.test('one location event after replay', () => pm.expect(events.length).to.eql(1)); }

if(events.length!==1){if(Date.now()<Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('waitDeadline'))){setTimeout(() => pm.execution.setNextRequest('Wait for status update history'), 250);}else{pm.test('status event processed once',()=>pm.expect(events.length).to.eql(1));}}else{pm.test('normalized status and history',()=>{pm.expect(events[0].status).to.eql('IN_TRANSIT');pm.expect(b.data.some(x=>x.status==='CREATED')).to.be.true;});}
pm.test('rejected transition has no occurrence', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.filter(x => x.locationText === 'Backward')).to.be.empty);

Promise.all([send('IN_TRANSIT',names[0]),send('TRANSFERRED',names[1])]).then(results=>{pm.collectionVariables.set('concurrentAccepted',JSON.stringify(results.filter(x=>x.status===202).map(x=>x.locationText)));pm.collectionVariables.set('concurrentRejected',JSON.stringify(results.filter(x=>x.status!==202).map(x=>x.locationText)));pm.test('concurrent responses are accepted or rejected transition',()=>{results.forEach(x=>pm.expect([202,409,422]).to.include(x.status));pm.expect(results.some(x=>x.status===202)).to.be.true;});}).catch(e=>pm.test('concurrent requests completed',()=>{throw e;}));

if(counts.some(n=>n!==1)&&Date.now()<Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('concurrentDeadline'))){setTimeout(() => pm.execution.setNextRequest('Wait for concurrent history'), 250);}else{pm.test('one occurrence per accepted status, without loss',()=>counts.forEach(n=>pm.expect(n).to.eql(1)));pm.test('rejected statuses have no occurrence',()=>JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('concurrentRejected')||'[]').forEach(name=>pm.expect(b.data.filter(x=>x.locationText===name)).to.be.empty));}

if(events.length!==1){if(Date.now()<Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('waitDeadline'))){setTimeout(() => pm.execution.setNextRequest('Wait for first status history'), 250);}else{pm.test('status event processed once',()=>pm.expect(events.length).to.eql(1));}}else{pm.test('normalized status and history',()=>{pm.expect(events[0].status).to.eql('IN_TRANSIT');pm.expect(b.data.some(x=>x.status==='CREATED')).to.be.true;});}
